Hero_Desc_HaleySane:
Haley confronted the pain of the past that held her captive and finally reclaimed herself.
Since regaining her senses, she has once again displayed her former excellence in fields such as tactics and diplomacy.
Even so, she still occasionally shows flashes of the eccentric Haley we remember.
Album_Wish_HaleySane: For no one to suffer over defeat
Album_HaleySane1: For once, Haley appeared in something other than her usual uniform. I wondered whether something had happened, but as we spoke, reason could be heard between her words... Huh? Haley seems different.
Album_HaleySane2: The recent events around the Order appear to have put Haley through a great deal. After losing consciousness and waking again, fragments of her old memories gradually began returning. I am relieved that she regained her senses, but it troubles me that I failed to notice how much she must have suffered.
Album_HaleySane3: Now that she has regained her senses, Haley says she has decided to acknowledge and fully accept her past and its painful memories. I chose to encourage and support her resolve.
Album_HaleySane4: Apparently, only those close to Haley truly know that she has recovered. Hilde and Lethe oversee her treatment, so their knowledge is natural, but Heidi was somewhat unexpected. She discovered the truth naturally by following Haley around for interviews after she woke.
Album_HaleySane5: Having regained her senses, Haley has not publicly announced her recovery and continues an ordinary life. When asked why, she thoughtfully replied that she did not want to cause another disturbance in an Elven society already destabilized by many events.
Album_HaleySane6: Haley seems to be gradually trying to change her manner of speech. She says the military tone of command she used as an officer has become so habitual that it is difficult to shake. After talking with her briefly, it appeared she still needed a little more practice.
Album_HaleySane7: Although Haley has stepped down from her position as an officer, she intends to continue leading exchanges between Monatium and the Order in a diplomatic capacity. Her hope that no one else would quarrel from poor communication and be left with regret resonated deeply with me.
LoveHero_HaleySane: You place your trust in me? Hehe, I will not disappoint you.
LoveHeroCancel_HaleySane: Even if we part for a while, the direction we travel will always remain the same.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Hate1: She frowned the moment she saw the bowl of ice cream. Apparently, she worried that eating it might cost her the sanity she had only just recovered.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Hate2: The suffering that comes with staying up all night seems less severe than before, but she remains wary of coffee. She says drinking too much gives her headaches.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like1: Haley says plain rice still reminds her of the warmth of her past. The comfort of a warm bowl of rice seems to have reached her as well.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like2: Haley's expression as she lightly held the teacup radiated ease and comfort. Even I, who had prepared the meal, felt my heart grow peaceful.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like3: After one spoonful, she gave an exceptionally satisfied smile. As expected, the warm and filling rice cake soup suited her perfectly.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like4: As she ate, Haley nodded contentedly and said it felt like taking a walk through a peaceful forest.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like5: She said she liked the tart flavor and quickly tossed it into her mouth. Her eyes seemed to glisten with tears, but perhaps I imagined it.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like6: Looking at the individually separated songpyeon, Haley smiled with relief and said there would be no reason to fight when sharing them.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like7: She ate contentedly, saying sweets calm the heart and make the mind work faster. Her only complaint was that eating too many made her drowsy.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like8: She praised food that can be eaten anywhere as having great tactical value. She nodded, adding that the flavor was naturally excellent as well.
Food_ChefNote_HaleySane_Like9: Before eating the candy, Haley examined it from every angle with a profound gaze. She then praised it in an unusually bright voice, saying she sensed the meaning of peace and harmony within it.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_HaleySane: I will accompany you on the path toward Elias's future.
Gacha_Result_Line1_HaleySane: The pain and scars of the past... I will accept them all.
Gacha_Result_Line2_HaleySane: Clarity has returned to her eyes
HaleySane_Spawn2: There is no hesitation on the road ahead!
HaleySane_Growth: I am Haley. A pleasure to work with you.
HaleySane_Growth1: This will give us more tactical options.
HaleySane_Growth2: Effort and growth have no end.
HaleySane_Victory1: A victory achieved through everyone's strength.
HaleySane_Victory2: It has been a long time since I felt this sense of accomplishment.
HaleySane_Defeat2: Next time... the result will differ.
HaleySane_Affinity1_1: What a peaceful view. It brings peace to the mind as well. Do you feel the same, Master?
HaleySane_AffinityExpansion1: It is time, Master. Shall we begin our new routine together?
HaleySane_Affinity1_2: You wish to see the swordsmanship of an Elphinia officer? Hehe, I see no reason not to show you!
HaleySane_Affinity2: If your thoughts are tangled, why not take a leisurely walk once in a while?
HaleySane_AffinityExpansion2: Good morning. I look forward to another day with you, Master.
HaleySane_Affinity1_3: Even when something makes no tactical sense, circumstances sometimes demand that it be done.
HaleySane_Affinity3: My body certainly does not respond as readily as it once did. I am a little stiff.
HaleySane_AffinityExpansion3: The entirety of this day belongs to you. Keep your spirits up!
HaleySane_Affinity4: Fighting and winning is not always the answer. Sometimes another way may exist.
HaleySane_Affinity5: I am always grateful to Hilde and Lethe. Without them, I surely would have suffered far more.
HaleySane_Affinity6: Facing the past is painful, but I believe it holds equal value.
HaleySane_Affinity7: From now on, I intend not to suffer or regret what has already passed. I must focus more on what lies ahead.
HaleySane_Die1: Khng, is this as far as I go...?
HaleySane_Die2: We need to revise our strategy...
HaleySane_LevelUp: With greater strength comes greater responsibility.
HaleySane_Equipment: Thorough preparation is the foundation of everything!
HaleySane_HeroSkill: Technical training... It brings back memories.
HaleySane_HeroUpgrade: I will grow even stronger, so that I never repeat my mistakes.
HaleySane_Board: Are you ready to move with me?
HaleySane_DeckSetting2: With me here, there will be no gaps in our formation.
HaleySane_Stage: If we must fight, we shall surely be victorious!
HaleySane_Touch1_1: Ngh, that hurts. Could we settle this with words?
HaleySane_Touch2_1: It feels as though all my bad memories are flying away.
HaleySane_Touch1_2: Hmm, I let my guard down. Your hand is rather quick.
HaleySane_Touch2: My heart feels at peace. Thank you, as always.
HaleySane_Touch2_2: I do not think I could ever forget this touch of yours, Master.
HaleySane_DutchRubEnd2: Th-this could become a diplomatic incident!

HaleySane_AsideGet: I believe that properly facing the past is the road to the future.
HaleySane_AsideUpgrade: No matter how long I look, there is no end. I suppose I must accept that too.
HaleySane_Ultimate1: At last, the time has come!
HaleySane_Birthday: Happy birthday. I, Haley, shall continue to lend all my strength to the path you take.
HaleySane_Gacha2: I will accept all the pain and scars of the past.
HaleySane_Gacha3: I will accompany you on the path toward Elias's future.
HaleySane_Line1: A long road still lies ahead. Everyone, take heart!
HaleySane_Line2: I shall always protect the peace of Monatium, the Order, and Elias.
HaleySane_Line3: Will everyone lend their strength to one as lacking as I am?
HaleySane_Lobby: Before knowing the enemy, one must know oneself!
HaleySane_SolveHomework: Do not worry, Master. I responded tactically to keep the losses as low as possible.
LoveLetter_HaleySane:
Master!
I am writing this letter while taking a walk with Lethe. Sitting beneath the warm sunlight brought you to mind.
I am gradually adjusting to life outside the hospital. The days when I woke staring at the hospital ceiling still feel like yesterday.
Would you join me for a walk and an honest conversation someday? I want to show you the Haley who has accepted her past and her wounds, and grown from them.
LoveCall_HaleySane:
Good to speak with you, Master.
No, I did not call because anything special happened.
I merely wanted to talk with you for a moment and make sure you were well.
Yes, consider it a casual courtesy call for the sake of diplomatic relations with the Order.
Haha, does hearing from me make you think something must have happened in Monatium or Elias? I suppose it might.
But there truly is no particular reason today, so do not worry. You may rest easy.

By the way, the weather in Elias is lovely today. Have you seen it?
At times like this, one should take a leisurely walk, regain some composure, and set one's thoughts in order.
If you are not too busy, Master, how about going for a walk?
I happen to have some free time as well, so if you do not mind, I could join you.
I would like to walk slowly together while admiring the peaceful, unhurried scenery.
Excellent. Then decide on a time and place and contact me. I will be waiting.
Hehe, I look forward to it.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP01_001: Mediating disputes between citizens is no simple task... Do you have a good way to resolve such matters, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP01_003: Master... Was that a joke? I shall assume it was.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP01_004: Trying to listen carefully to each person's position?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP01_005: An answer worthy of you, Master. I can think of no other method either. Is dialogue the answer after all...?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP01_006: I do not think there is any particular method.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP01_007: ...Is that so? I expected you to have something, Master... How disappointing.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP02_001: Wearing my old clothes again after so long feels awkward. Do I look strange?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP02_002: I do not see much difference.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP02_003: Are you perhaps the sort of person who takes little interest in clothing, Master? In any case, I shall take that to mean I do not look strange.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP02_004: It is fine. You look even better than before.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP02_005: Thank you for saying so, Master. I feel as though my confidence has returned!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP02_007: Sniff... So you felt that way too, Master...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_001: I recently read the article Heidi wrote about me. Have you seen it too, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_002: I read it... Was Haley truly that remarkable?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_003: Master... How have you been viewing me all this time?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_004: I was surprised that Heidi wrote it...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_005: I did not expect Heidi to write it that way either. It seems everyone thought similarly.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_006: Yes. It was an incredibly moving article.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP03_007: To be honest, it was somewhat embarrassing... Still, I was glad that it seemed to help many citizens trust me.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_001: Master! Are you managing your stamina properly? Sometimes your exhaustion is plain to see.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_002: To be honest, I am too busy to manage it separately...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_003: Master! Stamina is the most fundamental of fundamentals. If you do not know what to do, I can teach you the Elven Vanguard's exercise routine. Will you follow me?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_004: U-Um, I am managing it well, so do not worry!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_005: Hmm... That answer is unconvincing. Do not overexert yourself. Many Apostles would worry if you collapsed. Naturally, that includes me...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_006: I thought I was exercising in my own way...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP04_007: So you were making an effort... I understand. Your work as Master cannot be light.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_001: Master, you appeared to have many matters to handle the other day. Is there anything I can help with?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_002: I appreciate the thought, but I am fine.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_003: If you need me later, will you tell me? I will come at once for any request from you, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_004: Recover quickly and help prepare for the expedition.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_005: As expected, there was no helmsman as skilled as I, haha!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_006: I am still somewhat uneasy, so please remain still for now...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP05_007: Master...! I truly have recovered completely! Sniff...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_001: Sometimes I worry that the citizens of Monatium find me intimidating. Can you advise me on what to do, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_002: Simply not behaving as you did before should be enough.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_003: Is that not something I should naturally do...? I expected better advice from you, Master...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_004: Sometimes a little distance may be necessary...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_005: ...I do not know what you experienced, but you mean that maintaining order sometimes requires distance.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_006: You are already doing well just as you are now.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP06_007: I-Is that so? Is that how I appear to you, Master? Hearing you say so brings me some relief.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP07_001: I am curious what you consider important in a meal. May I ask, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP07_003: Hmm... Indeed, flavor is important for maintaining soldiers' morale! A good answer.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP07_005: You finally understand what I have been saying, Master! Calories are extremely important.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP07_006: I have never thought about such things.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP07_007: Hmm... Is that because you have no experience as a soldier? It seems our ways of thinking still differ greatly.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP08_001: Have you ever felt dizzy while riding the Bread Cruiser, Master? Other Apostles sometimes complain of motion sickness...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP08_003: Hmm... It has been quite some time since I last served at the helm. I shall be more careful from now on.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP08_004: Your piloting may be somewhat rough...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP08_005: What? Is that true? I always thought I was piloting it well...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP08_006: Sometimes it is comfortable enough for me to fall asleep aboard it.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP08_007: Is that so? That is a relief, but I should discuss possible improvements with Orr.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_001: I cannot think of a way to make the Bread Cruiser even safer... Do you have any ideas, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_002: Is it not already safe enough?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_003: Master, safety is one thing for which no amount of preparation is sufficient. Is it not worthy of careful consideration?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_004: Rotating shifts for the Suppression Unit?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_005: The Suppression Unit members would become tired, but it could help the Elves in the long term... Not bad. I shall propose it.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_006: I think it is already safe because Haley is there.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP09_007: Haha! Are you not exaggerating for my sake? Still, I am grateful that you think of me that way, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_001: Sometimes I think how wonderful it would have been to have an adjutant like you, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_002: Does that mean your previous adjutants were not very good...?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_003: Th-That is not what I meant! I have caused a misunderstanding.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_004: I am glad you think so highly of me.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_005: Anyone who had seen all you have accomplished would think the same.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_006: Are you not evaluating me too highly?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP10_007: I believed my assessment was accurate. Is it not? Being too strict with yourself is not good either.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP11_001: Do you ever miss Elli... No, your homeland, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP11_002: Well, I scarcely remember it now.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP11_003: Hmm... I understand. When one remains away from home for a long time, the memories gradually grow indistinct.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP11_005: It seems you feel much as we do, Master... Let us strive to return someday.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP11_006: Elias, with all of you here, feels like home now.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP11_007: As the only human, you must often feel lonely, yet you have adapted well. Well done, Master!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP12_001: I have lived by a strict routine for so long that I do not know what to do with spare time. Can you recommend something, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP12_003: I already do that as Propaganda Unit Chief, but if I can help the citizens more, it would be worthwhile.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP12_004: How about lazing around in your room?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP12_005: Master... Even with spare time, I would prefer to avoid anything that might encourage laziness...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP12_006: Shall I help you find something?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP12_007: Will you remain with me until we find it, Master? Then I gladly accept!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP13_001: Watching you cook reminds me of when I prepared meals in the field myself, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP13_003: Of course. Basic cooking ability is necessary even for an officer's survival.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP13_004: Preparing space rations is not cooking.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP13_005: No! I mean cooking with real ingredients that one prepares oneself!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP13_006: Oh, something you cooked yourself? I am curious.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP13_007: Hehe... Someday I shall serve you homemade Elven emergency combat rations, Master. Look forward to it!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP14_001: I am Haley, First Vanguard Officer of the Elven Invasion Force! I shall now issue a new operation order!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP14_003: It was a joke. Are you not taking it too seriously? Still, seeing you respond that way makes it even more amusing for me.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP14_004: Haley, did you forget your medicine today?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP14_005: I-It was a joke... How awkward.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP14_006: It has been a long time since you made a joke like that.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP14_007: Haha. You noticed at once. Your eye remains as keen as ever, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP15_001: Ugh... I may have spent a long time in the hospital, but sometimes the thought of visiting one still feels unpleasant.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP15_003: Is that so? You have experienced something similar, Master! Now I understand why Hilde once recommended the Order as a place for counseling!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP15_004: Still, you need to attend diligently.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP15_005: Ugh... You say that too, Master. Then I suppose it cannot be helped...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP15_006: Would missing a few appointments truly matter?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP15_007: Master, Hilde discharged me because she trusted me. Betraying that expectation would... weigh upon my conscience.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP16_001: Everyone seems to tense up when I speak to them. I think I should practice telling jokes... but I do not know whose advice to seek.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP16_003: Hmm... Everyone stops laughing whenever that phantom tells a joke... Still, you recommended her, Master, so I shall visit.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP16_005: Does a high-ranking priest know much about jokes? I did not know that... I shall visit her!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP16_006: I am rather knowledgeable about jokes too.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP16_007: You are, Master? Well... Considering how well you respond to my jokes, that may be true. Then will you teach me?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_001: I remain vigilant for the peace of Elias... but to be honest, it is tiring sometimes. Are you all right, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_002: I become tired in much the same way.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_003: As expected, your position must be difficult too, Master...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_004: It is difficult, but let us persevere together.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_005: Good. Having such a reliable comrade reassures me. Let us persevere together.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_006: I am so accustomed to exhaustion that I cannot tell anymore.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP17_007: ...I understand that you perform an important role, but should you not visit a hospital sometimes?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP18_001: Whenever I visit Monatium 25, I cannot decide what to buy. Is there a menu item you recommend?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP18_003: Hmm? The menu item that Unit Chief Rohne likes? Monatium 25 sells it too? I should check.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP18_004: You used to eat the discarded lunchboxes without worrying about the menu...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP18_005: Th-That was only before! I buy my own meals now.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP18_006: Would it not be best to ask Xion?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP18_007: Indeed, asking a store clerk would provide the most reliable answer. I shall ask her myself next time!
Affinity_HaleySane_EP19_001: May I ask your opinion on building better relations with the other races of Elias, Master?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP19_003: I do not believe we have held an official program like that since arriving in Elias. Thank you for the good idea, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP19_004: As long as the Elves do not betray us...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP19_005: Master... Please do not say such things in front of the other Elves...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP19_006: Should the Order host a cultural exchange event?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP19_007: It is a good idea... but I worry it would place an even greater burden upon you, Master.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP20_001: There must be other citizens suffering symptoms similar to mine, but I cannot think of a way to help them...
Affinity_HaleySane_EP20_003: A lecture... I am not certain that speaking about my recovery would help.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP20_004: How about creating a discussion group?
Affinity_HaleySane_EP20_005: Gather citizens in similar circumstances so they can empathize with one another? That seems like a sound plan.
Affinity_HaleySane_EP20_007: Yes. Hilde cured me, so it would be best for them to seek her help as well.
